programme.title: The Zoo: A Warthog Named Peaches
programme.desc: Peaches, a 2-month-old warthog, charms his keepers while training to become an animal ambassador a nervous one-horned rhino adjusts to her new exhibit Willow, a red panda, shows signs of being pregnant.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Baby the Bully
programme.desc: Jackson meets bully cat, Baby, who's holding all the female cats hostage, causing them to hide in the bathroom Jackson comes to the aid of an interior designer's couch destroying cats, one of which is shedding pounds on a hunger strike.

programme.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Shark Island
programme.desc: Biologist and predator specialist Dave Salmoni journeys to an island in the South Pacific, which is home to a large concentration of sharks.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: It's a Baby Giraffe!
programme.desc: Rosie the giraffe is ready to give birth Robert has a bloody encounter with a wild python that has entered an enclosure Terri helps the keepers wrangle Chief the Tasmanian devil.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans: Relocating a Wild Male
programme.desc: Chiquita was only 2 months old when she arrived, but now at 3 years old, her surrogate attachment to a staffer causes developmental issues staffers head out to find a wild male spotted outside the borders of the reserve.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: At All Costs
programme.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's 19 rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.

programme.title: Monster Mako
programme.desc: Little is known about the large mako sharks that live in the Gulf of Mexico, the fastest and most elusive shark species.

programme.title: The Zoo: The Kings of Queens
programme.desc: A trio of new penguin chicks are introduced to the pool for their first swim family dynamics change when the mandrill monkey troop welcomes a new baby a pair of king vultures are prepped for their big debut at the Queens Zoo.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Sister Smackdown
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Jackson helps a cat named Charlee rebuild the confidence that her sister cat, Frankie, has nearly beaten out of her The Cat Daddy must crack the case of a pee-soaked apartment in order help a family with multiple cats.
